capabilities: Generate tags for a file or folder with AI and write them to frontmatter
Batch-tag folders with configurable recursion depth
Manage and switch multiple prompt templates
Generate custom frontmatter fields via {{key: prompt}} syntax
Exclude files from tagging using gitignore-style glob patterns
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; installation via the community directory was pending at time of writing.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to generate tags automatically, so tagging notes consistently by hand is tedious, especially across many files.

relations.evidence: Supports OpenAI-compatible APIs (ChatGPT, DeepSeek, Zhipu, Moonshot, etc.) and local Ollama models
Use the BRAT plugin to add this repository

summary: AI-powered tag generator that writes tags into note frontmatter using OpenAI-compatible APIs or local Ollama models.
